hello.speaker: Keeper Ada
hello.text: The orchard stopped singing. Will you bring its signal back?

history.speaker: Keeper Ada
history.text: Our sentinel mistook the repair crew for a storm. It only needs a gentle shutdown.

mission.speaker: Keeper Ada
mission.text: Take my signal tuner. Collect the amber coil ahead, quiet the sentinel with three strikes, then use the relay door.

thanks.speaker: Keeper Ada
thanks.text: There it is: the orchard song. What should we build here next?
